text.Since I started spending money on the ha: Tangu nianze kutumia pesa kwenye saluni ya nywele, kujiamini kwangu hudumu mwezi mzima.
text.When my hair and eyebrows are neat, I lo: Nywele na nyusi zangu zikiwa nadhifu, hujitazama kwenye kioo na kuwaza, “Hata leo sionekani vibaya.”
text.Then I want to go out, and talking with: Kisha nataka kutoka nje, na kuzungumza na watu kumekuwa kufurahisha zaidi kuliko zamani.
text.I especially want people who think, like: Ningependa hasa wale wanaofikiri kama nilivyofikiri zamani, “Sihitaji kutumia yen 5,000 kwa nywele zangu,” wajaribu mara moja.
